scope: Isolated current-behavior probes; reproduced=true confirms a gap, not product acceptance.

findings.result: Second same-day/channel income is rejected instead of accumulated.
Confirmed AI entry with omitted note cannot have amount edited via table until note is supplied.
Only store channel reported; summary.complete=true describes costs, with no revenue-completeness signal.
Retrying add after another edit returns undo token for that later edit; undo reverses the other edit.
Exact replay of successful edit is rejected; request identity is not consumed by edit.
No negative-income/refund type or editable occurrence timestamp; only business day and system creation timestamp.
Report returns selected-day entries and seven-day summaries; older posted entries require another day query.
